notes.title: RoboRob Version 1.2.0 - Final Update Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[b]New Features[/b]

 [list]
[*]    Level Select System: Added interactive 3D pressure plates to the level selection area. Completed levels now display visual indicators, allowing for easy replay.
[*]     Auto-Save Progress: Level completions are now saved automatically, making previously completed levels accessible in the level select area.
[*]     Updated End-Level Trigger: Replaced the end-level portal with a mechanical pressure pad, better fitting the game’s industrial theme.
[/list]

[b]Gameplay & Visual Updates[/b]

[list]
[*]     Orbit Camera: Switched from a static camera to an orbit camera, allowing players to adjust their perspective for a clearer view of puzzles.
[*]     Lift Enhancements: Lifts now move smoothly between points with adjustable wait times. Players will stay securely on the lift during movement.
[*]     Achievement Tracking: Achievements are awarded upon level completion and are now tracked automatically per level.
[*]     UI & Level Pad Visuals: Improved UI and added green indicators on level pads to highlight completed levels.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*]     Fixed an issue where players could fall off moving lifts.
[*]     Resolved a problem with cursor visibility during gameplay.
[*]     Fixed cases where the end-level UI could trigger prematurely.
[/list]

[b]Notes[/b]

Version 1.2.0 completes RoboRob with enhanced navigation, camera control, and replay options. Thank you for joining us on this journey, and stay tuned for RoboRob 2!

notes.title: Robo Rob Level Overhaul: Your Input Needed!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

I wanted to inform you all that I will be remaking the levels of Robo Rob. Over the past few months, I've learned a lot and realized that some of the levels are not up to the standard I aim for.

One of the main issues is the lack of skill progression. The puzzles are currently mixed, meaning you might encounter a difficult level followed by a very easy one, which disrupts the flow and doesn't make sense.

Additionally, the jump pads have been problematic. Many of you may know they are broken, and despite significant development time spent trying to fix them, I've decided to remove them. I will be replacing these levels with new content. Your ideas and recommendations are welcome, so please share them on our Discord server.

[url=https://discord.gg/jwgZWG6Gh8]Join our Discord[/url]

Thank you for your understanding and support.
